summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the launch of a global follow-on offering of approximately €75 million ($87 million). The offering consists of ADSs in a U.S. public offering and ordinary shares with pre-funded warrants in an international offering to qualified investors in Europe and elsewhere, without preferential subscription rights. Jefferies, TD Cowen, and Stifel serve as global coordinators. Proceeds support the company's late-clinical stage pipeline. The offer is subject to underwriting; underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to 15% additional ADSs. Closing expected after satisfaction of customary conditions.
